name: The Oracles Project
notes: Native port (not a ROM-patching emulator) of Oracle of Ages/Seasons - self-contained, no game file to point at, so args_template is empty and it launches standalone like any other 'recomp' integration_mode entry. Confirmed against the real GitHub repo via a live releases fetch + asset-pattern match - 5 releases found; v1.4.0 and v1.3.0 each resolve a real linux-x86_64.AppImage download URL, v1.2.0 and older only ship a linux-x86_64.tar.gz, which this launcher's installer doesn't extract yet (same .tar.gz gap noted in the README roadmap) - those versions correctly show 'No matching asset' rather than installing something broken. Repo/asset-pattern verified for real; the actual download/install/launch round-trip hasn't been run on this machine yet.
